The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (April 21, 2022) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Ariba Document Number 3372382934 Description: For the non-exclusive supply, delivery, and application of Bacillus Thuringiensis Israelensis for Surface Water Larvaciding and Methoprene Granules (pellets) for City owned and maintained catch basins and Vectolex Water Soluble Pouches to be used in environmentally sensitive catch basins. It also includes mosquito larvae surveillance and adult mosquito trapping for the City of Toronto Public Health Division.
